_comment: Symbol-local placement geometry for netlist-to-schematic work. Default variant applied (as the editor places it). Origin at body center, +x east, +y south, units = canvas units (pin grid = 2, artwork grid = 10). Transform: world = origin + mirror(rotate(local)); mirror=horizontal flips x (left-right), vertical flips y (top-bottom), per packages/model/src/geometry.ts + orientation-reflect.ts. vdd-port and ground are fixed as authored (vdd pin faces down, ground pin faces up); mos/bjt allow mirror; others rotate-only.
